title: Choose the portal's world
question: The roll assigned Braun Programme. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Braun Programme
options.lineage: Braun product language, 1956-1985 (Rams, Gugelot, ET66, SK4, 606)
options.thesis: A well-made appliance for agents: one lamp per state, and yellow only ever means you.
options.viewport: Inbox column left with yellow keys; agents by repository; conversation centre with a pinned composer; todo programme right; hosts as perforated grilles in the top bar.
options.risk: Light grey reads dated or beige if the type and lamps are set timidly.

raised.raise: Every number (ages, counts, cores, todo tallies) sits in one tabular-figure column rhythm.
Regions are whole cells of one 8px module; the joints between work areas stay visible as hairline rules.
Status lamps follow a fixed size ramp: needs-you largest, running next, idle smallest.
Disabled actions lose colour entirely: with Herdr down, the composer and key buttons go flat grey.

options.label: The Pass
options.lineage: restaurant expo station: ticket rail, heat lamps, the window
options.thesis: The owner works the pass: every lead is a ticket on the rail, and what needs you is called at the window.
options.viewport: The window (inbox) fixed left; every lead as a ticket clipped to a rail across the top; the selected ticket opens below as conversation and todo checklist.
options.risk: The ticket rail resembles a kanban board, the arrangement many tools in this category land on.

options.label: Transit Line
options.lineage: metropolitan rail diagrams on midnight enamel
options.thesis: Every repository is a line, every lead a station, every todo a stop on its route.
options.viewport: Repository lines across the top with lead stations and worker branches; inbox as service alerts left; conversation centre; the todo route as a vertical line right.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: lead-to-worker branches read better than any list; holds clarity, ties on audience.
options.risk: The diagram needs a strict 45/90 grid or it turns decorative; a dark ground beside Herdr.

options.label: Coupon Book
options.thesis: Each lead's plan is a coupon book: done legs are stamped used, dropped ones void, and the stub shows what remains.
options.viewport: Inbox as a strip of tags across the top; leads as tabbed coupon heads left; conversation centre; coupon-book todos right.
options.case: Fuses on todos: 154 done and 22 abandoned items read as used and void; holds clarity, loses audience identification.
options.risk: Stamps and coupon edges become a costume fast; navy and red read airline, not tooling.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Agent activity as barcode fields in pure black and white.
options.viewport: Columns of activity bars per agent with dense numeric margins.
options.case: Fuses poorly: black and white alone cannot carry running, waiting and blocked states.
options.kept: Every number sits in one tabular-figure column rhythm.
options.risk: Reads as an art piece, not a console.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The screen built on a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: Monumental counts over a visible cell grid.
options.case: Monumental type wastes a working screen; designers identify with it more than developers.
options.kept: Regions snap to whole cells of one module, with visible hairline joints.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Agents as stars, urgency as magnitude.
options.viewport: A field of agent dots sized by urgency.
options.case: Agents are not points in a field; chat and todos lose their structure.
options.kept: Status lamps follow a fixed three-step size ramp.

options.label: Warm App Surface
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, one action colour.
options.viewport: One card per agent in a scrolling column.
options.case: Soft cards and thumb targets misfit a dense desktop console.
options.risk: Low density on a large monitor.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark agent console that Linear, Slack and Cursor users already know, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Inbox pinned left; agents; conversation with composer; todos panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other agent console by design.
